cases.why: Kit format: only the severity sections count, a refuted candidate and praised lines do not, a fence does not end the findings, a heading's identifier beats a priority word in its body.

Free text with CRLF: a bold line naming the merge is BLOCKING, a non-blocking heading is not, backticked, L-prefixed, absolute and worded citations resolve, a span of forty lines matches nothing, a severity cell beats a word in the prose.
Security record: only the Findings section counts, its field tables stay with their finding, Medium for D1 is accepted.
A heading naming a severity does not shut out the findings under a heading that names none.
